get.description: Unauthenticated: tell the frontend whether Google SSO is required.

schema.title: Response List Datasets Api Datasets Get

get.description:
Return a PAGINATED, searchable page of conversation summaries.

``q`` matches conversation ext_id OR message content. ``status``/``topic``
filter on the effective segmentation. ``labeler`` restricts the page to that
labeler's worklist assignments. Shape: ``{items,total,page,page_size}``.
Return a conversation's messages plus its effective + gold segments.

post.description:
REPLACE all gold for a conversation with the posted spans (split/merge).

Each new span inherits topic/subtopic/sentiment from the overlapping
predicted segment when the client leaves them unset.

get.description:
Return the predicted-segment review queue with gold review state.

Filters (optional): ``status`` (``reviewed``/``unreviewed``), ``topic`` exact
match, ``max_confidence`` (keep segments at or below that confidence).

schema.title: Response List Segments Api Datasets  Dataset  Segments Get

get.description: Return a segment with its conversation messages, span, and siblings.

delete.description: Clear a segment's relabel/confirm gold, reverting it to unannotated.

post.description: Write a relabel/confirm gold mirroring the predicted span with new labels.

get.description: Return review progress: totals and per-topic counts on the effective set.

delete.description: Remove a taxonomy option. Already-applied segment labels are left intact.

schema.title: Response Get Taxonomy Api Datasets  Dataset  Taxonomy Get

patch.description: Rename a taxonomy option, cascading the rename to applied segment labels.

post.description: Add a taxonomy option (idempotent: a duplicate create is a no-op).
Fold one topic into another: cascade labels then drop the duplicate rows.

get.description: Return distinct topic names already used for the dataset, frequent first.
